Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi20GraphicalProjectionWriter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi20GraphicalProjectionWriter
public final class Dexpi20GraphicalProjectionWriter extends Object
Opt-in adapter from the exchange-neutral graphical projection to DEXPI 2.0 Core primitives.

The adapter emits only generic Core Diagram, RepresentationGroup, Static, Polygon, PolyLine, and Text objects. It never invents a DEXPI profile symbol. Every identity or graphical property that cannot be mapped is recorded in the returned structured report.

  • Method Details

    • write

      public static Dexpi20GraphicalProjectionReport write(ProcessSystem processSystem, EngineeringGraphicalProjection projection, File file, Dexpi20PlantExportOptions options) throws IOException
      Writes a schema- and NeqSim-profile-valid DEXPI Plant exchange with opt-in generic graphics.

      The base Plant document is written first through Dexpi20XmlWriter. The graphical extension is validated in a temporary file and atomically replaces the destination only after both the bundled DEXPI XML schema and semantic profile pass.

      Parameters:
      processSystem - source simulation topology
      projection - controlled exchange-neutral graphical projection
      file - destination DEXPI XML file
      options - controlled Plant metadata and boundary handling
      Returns:
      deterministic structured mapping and loss report
      Throws:
      IOException - if base export, parsing, graphical serialization, or validation fails
